IELTS Preparation

Prepare for all four sections of IELTS.

Work through the Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking sections of the IELTS exam, with practice tasks and feedback aimed at a clear target band score.

Suggested learners
High School · Adult
Format
Guided, project-based learning
Schedule & tuition
Confirm with TTW before enrollment

What learning looks like

Skills with a purpose.

  • Practise exam-style Listening and Reading tasks under timed conditions.
  • Structure Writing Task 1 and Task 2 responses clearly and support them with evidence.
  • Build Speaking fluency and coherence through structured practice and feedback.

Illustrative project · Not a student result

Complete a full practice test and score review

Take a timed, full-length practice test across all four sections, then review the results section by section to identify the highest-impact areas to improve before the next attempt.

Activities depend on the learner’s level and confirmed course.

A starting point that fits.

Suited to high school and adult learners preparing for study, work or immigration requirements. Current target band, class format and schedule are not yet confirmed; ask TTW before enrolling.
